From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@nexgen.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ARR accuracy sweep — reconcile product mapping & close-plan gaps

Hi team / Maria,

Following up on last week's forecasting review — finance flagged a handful of mid- to late-stage NexGen deals where ARR, SKU mapping, and probability don't align with the close-plan notes. I pulled a short template and attached it (pipeline-hygiene-template.xlsx) to make the updates quick.

Top asks (can we treat this as a 48-hour sweep?):
- Verify Amount: make sure ARR equals the most recent contract quote. If it's a range, use the conservative midpoint and leave a note.
- Product/SKU: map NexGen internal codes to Redwood SKUs. If unsure, flag for Karthik.
- Next step & owner: ensure the next step is explicit (e.g., "Legal redline", "PO requested") and owner set.
- Probability: update probability to reflect current close-plan fidelity (not simply stage default).
- Close date sanity check: if the close date moved >30 days, add a one-line rationale.

I added a HubSpot link to the company record and pre-filled rows for the top 10 deals we referenced in the review: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Action owners: please update the sheet and push the changes into CRM (HubSpot) by end of day Thursday, Jul 9. Call out any deals you can't reconcile and I'll loop finance.

Attachments: pipeline-hygiene-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks — short and targeted please. This will feed tomorrow's forecast bake.

---
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0167

- Laura: updated NXG-41 amounts and probability.
- Karhtik: will review the two SKU flags (target Monday morning).
- Mateo: uploaded mapping (nexgen-sku-map.pdf) and left a HubSpot note.

If nothing else blocks, please finalize PO steps so we can mark NXG-41 as "Committed" in the next bake.
